content.subject: Thoughts on your new apparel fulfillment center
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that ShipMonk launched an apparel-specific fulfillment center to tackle returns and SKU complexity. I imagine keeping return records aligned across inventory systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We pull return data from each system and match it to a unified record, eliminating duplicate entry work.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
